headline: Indonesia Sets 5.4 Percent Economic Growth Target for 2026
summary: The Indonesian government targeted full-year economic growth of 5.4 percent for 2026, supported by household consumption and fiscal stimulus.
why: Indonesia is Southeast Asia's largest economy, and official GDP growth targets guide domestic fiscal policy and foreign investment expectations.

impacts.name: Indonesia
impacts.why: Official growth targets underpin government spending and domestic economic expansion projections.
